rulesText.explanation: Today is {{label}}: {{wang}} gives birth to {{xiang}} and shares the day's energy, so the {{xiangFamily}} and {{wangFamily}} are both lucky

木: Wood energy is unfolding — take a walk and look at some trees.
Water the plants at home and open a window for fresh air.
Stretch for a few minutes and loosen up.
A good day to start something new — write a to-do list.
火: Fire energy is bright — meet a friend for a chat.
Soak up some sun, but drink plenty of water.
Brighten up your room and your mood will follow.
A good day to speak up in meetings.
土: Earth energy is steady — finish things one by one.
Enjoy a proper meal and eat slowly.
Tidy a drawer or your desk for a grounded feeling.
Spend time with family doing small, steady things.
金: Metal energy is crisp — a good day to decide and declutter.
Take a few deep breaths and dress for the weather.
Sort out your files and accounts for a clear mind.
Set some rules or plans — give yourself a little ritual.
水: Water energy flows — read or learn something new.
Drink warm water and go to bed a little earlier.
Listen to music or soak your feet to calm down.
Reflect on things — a few lines of journal would be nice.
